output:
Subject: Yes, it’s true—a car hit my salon (I’m okay!)

Hi friends, neighbors, church family, and my long-time ladies,

By now you probably heard, and my phone is ringing nonstop, so let me answer the same question one time for everybody. Yes, a car went through the front window of Lotus Glow Nails on Bellaire Blvd. It happened Sunday, Nov. 8, around 2 in the morning. Nobody was inside. Thank God nobody was hurt. The driver is okay. Police came, and her insurance will pay. We have been open 11 years, and I am just thankful the shop was empty. God was protecting us.

The front glass is gone and one pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like she wanted a spa day. My daughter said the driver got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston. My husband looked at the floor and said, “Finally, the shop is modern art.” The floor looks like rainbow throw up, so maybe he is right.

I am okay. I cried a little in the morning, then I got myself together. Please don’t worry about me—laugh a little instead. The city inspector has to check the wall before we can open. The contractor says we can reopen Monday, Nov. 16. I will let you know if that changes.

This week, me, Trang, and Kim are working at my cousin Hoa’s salon, Pearland Nail Bar. Call or text me at 832-555-0147 for nails or questions.

Gift cards are still good. Nobody will lose money. Thank you for all the texts and food. Mrs. Dung brought pho this morning, and I am very grateful. Please pass this around in your group texts and emails so I don’t have to tell the story fifty times.

Love,
[Your name]
Lotus Glow Nails
